_comment: Detroit-Warren-Dearborn, MI MSA (CBSA 19820) - Wayne, Oakland, Macomb, Livingston, St. Clair and Lapeer counties. AUTHORED FROM SCRATCH 2026-08-07: no metro config existed and the metro was GREENFIELD - a query for every facility_listings row whose metro_area matched Detroit/Warren/Dearborn returned zero rows. Built under the v3 source-led coverage-first methodology including Stage 2b (database union as discovery) and Stage 2c (the unaggregated-venue pass). At 4.3M people this is the largest metro attempted; see _coverage_honesty. NOT YET IMPORTED as of authoring.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the MSA COUNTY LIST, never from an observed bounding box (Toledo/Winston-Salem/Greensboro precedent). An observed bbox is only a LOWER bound - it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it rejects a legitimate future venue at the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-relation bounding boxes for the six MSA counties, rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg: Wayne (relation/359767, lat 42.0279..42.4514, lng -83.5519..-82.7501), Oakland (relation/359761, lat 42.4312..42.8886, lng -83.6894..-83.0834), Macomb (relation/359762, lat 42.4472..42.8975, lng -83.1029..-82.7060), Livingston (relation/359765, lat 42.4239..42.7833, lng -84.1582..-83.6648), St. Clair (relation/574424, lat 42.4787..43.1689, lng -82.9962..-82.3354), Lapeer (relation/359763, lat 42.8804..43.3270, lng -83.4607..-82.9836). Edges are driven by Wayne (latMin), Lapeer (latMax), Livingston (lngMin) and St. Clair (lngMax).
_envelope_overreach: KNOWN AND RECORDED RATHER THAN SILENTLY NARROWED. The MSA is a ragged hexagon and an envelope is a rectangle, so THREE neighbouring CBSAs sit inside it and states:[MI] fences none of them. (1) ANN ARBOR MSA (CBSA 11460, Washtenaw County) sits ENTIRELY inside this rectangle - Ann Arbor, Ypsilanti, Pittsfield Twp, Saline, Chelsea, Dexter. This is not theoretical: SIX dormant OSM draft rows inside this envelope are Washtenaw's and are deliberately left untouched (see _stage_2b). (2) FLINT MSA (CBSA 22420, Genesee County) is largely inside it - Flint, Grand Blanc, Swartz Creek, Flushing, Clio, Davison, Linden. Also live: the Great Lakes Pickleball Association places-to-play page, this metro's single highest-yield regional source, carries a whole Genesee County section and every entry of it was excluded by county. (3) MONROE MSA (CBSA 33780) contributes only its northern sliver; most of Monroe County sits below latMin 42.02. Also inside the rectangle and excluded by county and by states:[MI]: WINDSOR, ONTARIO (42.3, -83.0), directly across the river from Detroit. Correctly OUTSIDE: Lansing (-84.55, west of lngMin), Toledo OH (41.65, below latMin), Saginaw and Bay City (north of latMax). If a Washtenaw, Genesee or Monroe row is ever admitted, tighten deliberately and name the row that forced it.
msa: Detroit-Warren-Dearborn, MI (Wayne, Oakland, Macomb, Livingston, St. Clair, Lapeer counties)
_require_all_geocoded_comment: false because 30 of the 121 venues carry a DELIBERATELY BLANK street address. Each is an authoring decision, not incomplete research: either no controlling source publishes a street address at all, or two sources publish irreconcilable ones (Bash Pickleball Club: 6881 Chicago Rd vs 31201 Chicago Rd S; Woodall/River Bends: three different addresses), or the only 'address' on offer is a street INTERSECTION rather than a house number (Upton Park, Whittier Park, Royal Oak) or a street name with no number at all (PARC Plymouth). A recalled address that is wrong is indistinguishable from a fabricated one, so those rows reach only the name-based geocode rungs and are expected to hold on 'no coordinate' rather than publish a wrong pin. Every one of them is a lookup, not a research problem - one address read releases each.
_stage_2b: UNION AGAINST THE DATABASE, run as DISCOVERY rather than dedupe. A query for every facility_listings row inside this envelope REGARDLESS of metro_area returned 9 rows, all metro_area NULL, all status draft, all source osm, all verified_by NULL. SIX are Washtenaw County (Ann Arbor MSA) and are left exactly as they are, untouched and unstamped: Cayman Sports (node/9020709618), Grewal Park Neighbor's Court (way/1420080439), Grewal Park Central Grove Court (way/1420080440), Grewal Park Volleyview Court (way/1420080441), North Campus Recreation Building (relation/17558946, U-M Ann Arbor) and Varsity Pickleball (node/13829328635, Ypsilanti). THREE are in scope and each became a candidate in this batch only after a non-aggregator citation was found for it, because an OSM row NAMES a candidate but does not CITE one: Wicked Pickle (node/13704528673) confirmed on the operator's own site; Livonia Athletic District (way/299830708) corroborated by Detroit Metro Times; and Woodhaven Pickleball Courts (way/397330554), which carried NO city and NO address and was resolved to Woodhaven Civic Center Park. This is the Syracuse pattern - live venues invisible on any metro page because nothing had ever claimed them.
_reconciles_comment: NO RECONCILES, deliberately. All three in-scope Stage 2b rows are raw OSM drafts carrying metro_area NULL that were re-researched and re-entered as fresh candidates in this batch rather than reconciled, because none was ever claimed by a metro and the batch is greenfield. They remain in the database as untouched drafts; nothing in this run stamps or publishes them.
_metro_specific_instruments: Three source classes were enumerated as FIRST-CLASS sources because Michigan's local-government structure makes a city-only sweep structurally blind. (1) CHARTER TOWNSHIPS are separate legal authorities from both the city and the county, each with its own parks and recreation department, and Oakland and Macomb counties are dense with them - Independence (Clintonwood Park), Orion (three venues), Clinton (Ray Hernandez courts), Macomb (two venues), Shelby, Washington, Chesterfield, Waterford, West Bloomfield, Brandon, Oxford, Hamburg, Canton, Van Buren, Attica and Imlay all carry venues in this batch that a city-only sweep would have missed entirely. Same structural class as Florida's CDDs and California's recreation and park districts. (2) JOINT RECREATION AUTHORITIES, a class this build did not expect and found anyway: R.A.R.E. (Recreation Authority of Roseville and Eastpointe), SELCRA (South East Livingston County Recreation Authority), the Howell Area Parks & Recreation Authority and RARA (Rochester Avon Recreational Authority) each operate venues that belong to no single municipality. (3) HURON-CLINTON METROPARKS, a REGIONAL authority spanning five counties. (4) The MICHIGAN DNR RECREATION GRANT award history was searched and returned NO pickleball award for any of the six MSA counties in the window read - the recent Recreation Passport pickleball awards were Allegan County's. That is an honest null result for this metro, not a skipped instrument.
_coverage_honesty: 121 venues for a 4.3M-person metro is 28 per million, against Tampa's 140 at 3.2M (44 per million). THAT GAP IS A THIN SWEEP, NOT A CEILING, and this config records it rather than letting the final number imply otherwise. The MSA contains roughly 130 municipalities and charter townships; approximately 45 were queried INDIVIDUALLY and confirmed, and the rest are covered only by the four regional sources (Great Lakes Pickleball Association, Detroit Metro Times, Visit Detroit, Oakland County Times). Named municipalities with parks departments that were NOT individually confirmed and are the highest-value target for a completion pass: Inkster, Romulus, Wayne, Garden City, Melvindale, Ecorse, River Rouge, Highland Park, Hamtramck, Grosse Ile, Brownstown Twp, Huron Twp, Sumpter Twp, Flat Rock, Gibraltar, Rockwood, Redford Twp, Eastpointe, Center Line, Utica, Armada, Richmond, Ray Twp, Lenox Twp, Bruce Twp, Berkley, Huntington Woods, Pleasant Ridge, Lathrup Village, Keego Harbor, Sylvan Lake, Orchard Lake, Farmington, Holly, Rose Twp, Groveland Twp, Addison Twp, Oakland Twp, Rochester, Walled Lake, South Lyon, Lyon Twp, Commerce Twp, Highland Twp, White Lake Twp, Green Oak Twp, Genoa Twp, Fowlerville, Marion Twp, Handy Twp, Tyrone Twp, and most of St. Clair County (Algonac, Marine City, St. Clair, Yale, Capac, Memphis, Clay Twp, Kimball Twp, Fort Gratiot Twp, Port Huron Twp) and Lapeer County (Almont, Dryden, Metamora, North Branch, Columbiaville). Per the v3 rule that every four-county metro has needed two passes, a six-county metro needs at least two and this is the first.
_stage_2c: THE UNAGGREGATED-VENUE PASS RAN AND PAID. No parks department lists a country club, a church gym, a private racquet club or a school district facility. Found this way: Troy Racquet Club, Franklin Athletic Club, The Sports Club of Novi, Oak Pointe Country Club, Ace Pickleball Club Bloomfield Twp, Clarkston United Methodist Church, Mount Zion Community Center, St. Clement Catholic Church Gym (Romeo), Durant High School, Lake Orion Community Education Resource Center, Pinckney Community Schools Navigator School, the JCC of Metropolitan Detroit, and four YMCA of Metropolitan Detroit branches. The UNIVERSITY sub-pass returned essentially nothing: Wayne State, Oakland University, U-M Dearborn, Macomb CC, Oakland CC and Lawrence Tech publish no pickleball court information that any source read surfaces. That is a real negative for a commuter-heavy metro, not a skipped instrument - and it is the OPPOSITE of Tampa, where Hillsborough Community College's tennis centre was found only via Stage 2b. LOCAL EDITORIAL was again the single most productive instrument: Detroit Metro Times (the alt-weekly) alone named 30 venues including most of the City of Detroit recreation centres, and C&G Newspapers supplied the Sterling Heights Athletic Hub, Madison Heights Rosie's Park, Birmingham Crestview Park, the Novi expansion and the RARE park.
_cross_state_contamination: CAUGHT AND EXCLUDED - CANTON. Searching Canton Township, Michigan (a genuine Wayne County MSA municipality that genuinely has pickleball) returned cantonparksandrec.com and the 'Hall of Fame City Pickleball Club'. That is CANTON, OHIO - the Pro Football Hall of Fame city - and it is the SAME SITE the v3 methodology already names in its own warning from Jackson MS, 2026-08-05. It resurfaced unprompted here because both Cantons are real pickleball municipalities. What made it catchable was the CLUB NAME, not the URL: 'Hall of Fame City' is a civic nickname belonging to exactly one town in America, while the hostname cantonparksandrec.com contains no state at all. Nothing was extracted from it. Canton Township MI's controlling entity is cantonmi.gov, confirmed on the source itself (footer 46555 W Michigan Avenue, Canton, MI 48188-1699; area code 734). Two further same-name near-misses were checked and cleared the same way: Taylor, TEXAS ranks alongside Taylor, MICHIGAN on the Heritage Park query (cityoftaylor.com + Pardee Road is Michigan's), and Warren OH / Warren PA / several out-of-state Warren COUNTY parks departments rank alongside the City of Warren, Michigan (cityofwarren.org).
_shared_saas_hostname_check: One row rests on a shared municipal-SaaS hostname: Pickle Park is cited to vanburentwp.recdesk.com. Per the Boise/Middleton precedent - middleton.recdesk.com is WISCONSIN's, not Idaho's, and neither hostname names its state - the state was confirmed OFF the hostname before the citation counted: Van Buren Charter Township, Wayne County, Michigan, corroborated by the Belleville Area Independent's ribbon-cutting coverage and the 734 area code.
_address_corrections_at_source: THREE addresses in the regional sources were wrong and were corrected against the controlling entity. (1) WILDLIFE WOODS PARK, NOVI is the sharpest: the Great Lakes Pickleball Association gives '26442 Wixom Rd., 48362' - a wrong street number AND a zip that belongs to Lake Orion - and the Oakland County Times places the same park in the CITY OF WIXOM. The City of Novi's own park page gives 26600 Wixom Road, Novi MI 48375. All three wrong values would have geocoded to somewhere plausible INSIDE this envelope with no guard firing. (2) MACOMB TOWNSHIP RECREATION CENTER: aggregators give 20699 Macomb Street; the township's own pickleball page gives 54111 Broughton Road, Macomb MI 48042. (3) UWM SPORTS COMPLEX, PONTIAC: the Great Lakes list gives 957 South Blvd E, Detroit Metro Times and the venue's own listings give 867 S Blvd E; the two agreeing sources are used.
_multi_campus_risk: Rows flagged for the Greensboro/Sedgefield failure mode - a geocode landing on the RIGHT organisation's WRONG CAMPUS, which resolves high-precision, in the right city, in the right zip, inside the envelope, and which no proximity guard catches: OAK POINTE COUNTRY CLUB (has a golf course, so the ladder can anchor on a course feature rather than the clubhouse); THE J / JCC OF METROPOLITAN DETROIT (two campuses, West Bloomfield and Oak Park - only West Bloomfield is imported); LAKE ST. CLAIR METROPARK (a large multi-feature regional park); HERITAGE PARK, TAYLOR (a regional park containing a library, a petting farm, a conservatory and a historical area, any of which can outrank the courts). Every new coordinate must be reverse-geocoded before publish.
